Chapter 1387 - 8: Exploration

Chapter 1387: Chapter 8: Exploration

"The Milky Way flows endlessly, with no beginning or end."

In the Tianhe dimension, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, observing the operation of the dimensional Origin Dao with the help of the Heart of the Heavenly River.

Compared to the stable chaos void dimension, the Tianhe dimension was more inclusive.

It didn’t even reject foreign time lifeforms.

While there were other factors, it was also related to the Tianhe dimension itself.

The inclusiveness of this dimension far exceeded that of the chaos void dimension.

"The Milky Way embraces all."

Lin Yuan’s expression was contemplative.

Within his internal universe, a mighty Milky Way gradually took shape.

This was Lin Yuan’s realization of the Tianhe dimension, manifested within his internal universe.

Now, Lin Yuan’s internal universe could no longer be described as a ’universe’.

It was more like a dimensional space, vast and boundless.

"The secret technique ’Milky Way’ I cultivated back then originated from this Tianhe dimension."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The secret technique "Milky Way" was a reward from the ninth layer Black Tower in the Demon Jade Space.

But its true origin was a slight realization of the Milky Way by the chaos void time lifeform ’Zhu Yin’.

These realizations spread and were eventually collected by the Moyu Tower Master, who summarized them before placing them in the ninth layer Black Tower.

"It seems I have some fate with this Tianhe dimension."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

The ’Milky Way’ secret technique he once cultivated was naturally far from the actual Tianhe dimension.

But it was one of the derivative secret techniques of the latter.

"Hmm?"

"Have they all left?"

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking into the distance.

At this moment, one by one, the time lifeforms began to leave, voluntarily vacating this dimensional space.

After smoothly retrieving the Heart of the Heavenly River, causing the nine time lifeforms of the Taixu dimension to pay the price.

Lin Yuan announced externally that he would take over this Tianhe dimension.

Any Second Realm time lifeform was the overlord of a dimensional gap area, so monopolizing the Tianhe dimension was entirely reasonable.

Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t voluntarily give up benefits within his grasp, whether inside or outside the dimensional space; strength was respected.

With powerful strength, one could occupy numerous resources and benefits.

Whereas those with weak strength would be exploited and suppressed.

And Lin Yuan’s strength was far beyond that of ordinary Second Realm time lifeforms.

In the battle with Gray Ancestor, although Lin Yuan did not keep the opponent.

It was clear to the discerning that in the clash between the two Second Realms,

Lin Yuan held the advantage, leading the Gray Ancestor to retreat and leave without hesitation.

Evidently, Lin Yuan’s strength was above Gray Ancestor, above ordinary Second Realm.

In this case, the time lifeforms who originally divided the Tianhe dimension could hardly have any other ideas.

After receiving the clear indication that Lin Yuan was taking over the Tianhe dimension, they retreated without hesitation.

If they didn’t retreat, were they waiting for Lin Yuan to sweep them out?

That way, even basic dignity would be lost.

For time lifeforms, the Tianhe dimension was precious.

But it wasn’t indispensable; the vast dimensional gaps didn’t contain just one Tianhe dimension.

"Not only did they leave gladly, but they also gave me the Heart of the Heavenly River."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, remembering how before the time lifeforms left, they voluntarily gave him the Heart of the Heavenly River they had gained in the past.

It was a way to express their attitude.

The regularly nurtured Heart of the Heavenly River was far inferior to the one Lin Yuan had just obtained.

It was merely a Thirteenth Level First Realm wonder.

The main use was to directly observe the operation of the Tianhe dimensional Origin Dao with its help.

As for refining it?

It only had some effect on the physical body of water-based time lifeforms.

It could slightly refine some physique.

Its practical significance wasn’t great.

If it left the Tianhe dimension, the Heart of the Heavenly River wouldn’t even compare to a First Realm wonder.

In this case, those time lifeforms naturally knew what to do.

Giving it to Lin Yuan and forming a good relationship with this Second Realm time lifeform was the best choice.

...

"Galaxy."

"Galaxy."

At this time, Lord Mo Xu and other time lifeforms appeared, calling out to Lin Yuan.

"How is it?"

"How are those Hearts of the Heavenly River serving you?"

Lin Yuan asked with a smile.

He took out a few additional Hearts of the Heavenly River, handing them to Lord Mo Xu and the others.

Ordinary Hearts of the Heavenly River essentially had no refining effect on Lin Yuan’s physical body.

Might as well leave them for Lord Mo Xu to observe the operation of the Tianhe dimensional Origin Dao.

After all, the operation of the Tianhe dimensional Origin Dao was there.

It wouldn’t decrease because another lifeform was watching.

Without affecting himself, Lin Yuan was still willing to help friends he had a good relationship with.

"Very good."

Lord Mo Xu and other time lifeforms immediately responded.

At the same time, a look of shame appeared on their faces.

Initially, they planned to snatch this Heart of the Heavenly River as a ’gift’ for Lin Yuan becoming a time lifeform.

But instead, they received Hearts of the Heavenly River from Lin Yuan.

Even this Tianhe dimension became part of the chaos void territory.

It should be known that Lord Mo Xu and seven time lifeforms went through countless battles and bloodshed to gain a foothold in the Tianhe dimension.

But it ultimately couldn’t compare to a single sentence from Lin Yuan—

The Tianhe dimension will be under my control from now on.

It was like an edict!

Just this one sentence made those time lifeforms, which gave Lord Mo Xu endless headaches, retreated obediently.

This made Lord Mo Xu and other time lifeforms feel like they were dreaming.

Especially Luo Hou, a mere newly promoted time lifeform, could actually directly enjoy the opportunity to observe the operation of the Tianhe dimensional Origin Dao?

If it was in the past, such a thing would never happen.

...

After a few more exchanges.

Lord Mo Xu and other time lifeforms left, continuing to comprehend and observe the operation of the Tianhe dimensional Origin Dao.
